summary: Critical outage in payments-gateway caused by dependency_failure (INC-0049)
description: Service payments-gateway incident INC-0049. Symptoms: third-party vendor API timeouts. Error: CircuitBreakerOpenException: Downstream service orders-service circuit breaker tripped. Root cause was dependency_failure. Followed runbook RB-bad-deploy-rollback.

comments.author: devops1
comments.body: Restarted service pods for payments-gateway and applied RB-bad-deploy-rollback.
